options.name: ad_domain_name
options.description: Specifies an active directory domain that this storage domain box is mapped to.

options.name: cluster
options.description: IP or FQDN for the Cohesity Cluster

options.name: cluster_partition_id
options.description: Specifies the Cluster Partition id where the Storage Domain is located.

options.name: cluster_partition_name
options.description: Specifies the Cluster Partition Name where the Storage Domain is located.

options.name: cohesity_admin
options.description: Username with which Ansible will connect to the Cohesity Cluster. Domain Specific credentails can be configured in following formats AD.domain.com/username AD.domain.com/username@tenant LOCAL/username@tenant

options.name: cohesity_password
options.description: Password belonging to the selected Username. This parameter will not be logged.

options.name: default_view_quota
options.description: Specifies an optional default logical quota limit (in bytes) for the Views in this Storage Domain. Supports two fields hard_limit_bytes and alert_limit_bytes

options.name: id
options.description: Specifies the Id of the Storage Domain. Applicable only when the domain is already created

options.name: kms_server_id
options.description: Specifies the associated KMS Server ID.

options.name: ldap_provider_id
options.description: Specifies the following provides the LDAP provider the storage domain is mapped to.

options.name: physical_quota
options.description: Specifies an optional quota limit (in bytes) for the physical usage of this Storage Domain. Supports two fields hard_limit_bytes and alert_limit_bytes

options.name: state
options.description: Determines the state of the Storage Domain Job

options.name: storage_policy
options.description: Specifies the storage options applied to the Storage Domain.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Switch determines if SSL Validation should be enabled.
